title: Quantifying and Mitigating Unimodal Biases in Multimodal Large Language Models: A Causal Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Using a causal framework with do-calculus to quantify the direct causal effect of irrelevant textual surface forms on model predictions, and evaluating models on the MORE dataset using multiple-choice distractors generated by text-only LLMs to test over-reliance on textual priors.

Using a causal framework to quantify the direct causal effect of irrelevant visual context on model predictions, and evaluating models on the MORE dataset using multiple-choice distractors derived from visually dominant entities that ignore specific textual constraints in the prompt.
